full_details: The almanac had nothing against the day. At the window you said two-and-twenty, and that nothing goes, and then that the matter is the girl and Shoreditch by nine. By seven the sheet had eleven new lines. They ask the day to be done. They are not a dawn, and they are not a gift. At eight you paid sixpence, the first coin of the firing and the washing. At the Theatre you set the death in the fourth act. Thomas Pope had read the Rose bill, Seven Days and Wise Man, and had not gone nearer than the post. You did not go. In the afternoon you were the old Roman, and you were off when the yard was still loud. Nothing went to Holborn.
one_sentence: You wrote eleven lines of her night, paid the first sixpence, and came off in the fourth act of Titus.
title: Wrote eleven lines and came off in the fourth of Titus
